Method of Attack: reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability allowing theft of sensitive user information or execution of malicious code
Discoverer: Clément Lecigne of Google Threat Analysis Group
Attack Vector: reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via user input in /opt/zimbra/jetty/webapps/zimbra/m/momoveto file parameter 'st'
Indicators of Compromise: exploitation observed in targeted attacks, including use by Winter Vivern Russian hacking group against NATO-aligned governments
